_comment: This file is the committed baseline for the k6 load-test suite (issue #1624).
_comment2: It is generated by running the suite and copying baselines/latest.json here.
_comment3: Update it intentionally when capacity or performance targets change.
_instructions: Run: k6 run --out json=backend/tests/load/baselines/latest.json backend/tests/load/suite.js, then copy latest.json to baseline.json and commit.
